summary: Season 12 (2025/26) Porsche 99X Electric customer programme. TWG AI is the primary partner (front); Quest Global, Crowe UK, HRX and Reflo are team partners per Andretti's Season 12 partner stack. Car-livery placements do not fit the schema; Porsche is a powertrain supplier, not a shirt-name sponsor.
